title: 'Post Scripta' grilles of 1583: dotted sheets for clear cover letters, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 ff.96-114 (DECODE R9319; catalogue 161)

steps.what: Web search for KAA 4591 and Augurelio ciphers
DECODE record list from the API dump (141 records in the volume); images of the 14 targets and 30 neighbouring keys fetched with the cookie
R9319 identified as dot grilles laid over clear cover letters; the cover letters (ff. 115-118) are not among the DECODE images (one shows through under f.102)

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from kaa4591 (catalogue 161), whose fourteen records are letters in at least six systems: System A′ stays in kaa4591; Łaski's System B is kaa4591b; R9325 is fulda1576; R9367, R9416, R9424 and R9319 are r9367, r9416, r9424 and r9319; R9291 is a key fragment.

outcome.method_basis: A dot grille gives no text without the letter it was laid over, and the cover letters are not imaged on DECODE.
outcome.notes: Blocked: needs images of ff. 115-118 from the archive.

gaps.detail: cover letters ff. 115-118 not imaged on DECODE
